title.narrative: The third UNESCO Global Engineering Report (ER III)

description.narrative:
The aim of this project is to produce the third UNESCO Global Engineering Report (ER III) within the framework of the International Decade of Sciences for Sustainable Development (IDSSD).
The ER III will provide insights into the global and regional engineering institutional and human capacities available by analysing statistics related to tertiary enrolment, graduation, and employment rates within the field of engineering, and key challenges in engineering education and employment. The ER III will propose actionable recommendations to address these challenges and meet future engineering demands.
The ER III will also highlight current trends in engineering and technology, showcasing the latest advancements, emerging technologies, and their implications for the engineering field. It will further highlight best practices and case studies from diverse regions to share how engineering challenges have been addressed.
Through the development process of ER III, training in gender-aggregated data collection and reporting will be provided to Member States to strengthen their capacities to create and maintain databases on engineering.
In the long-term, the ER III aims to influence evidence-based policymaking, raise awareness and enhance capacity-building to advance engineering and engineering education aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). This project is aligned with Agenda 2030 (SDG4 & SDG9) and 2063 African Union Agenda 2063 (Goal 1) by contributing to quality education and fostering innovation. Moreover, it will address the need for inclusive and equitable engineering practices, particularly in underserved communities.
